auditScope: Coverage only. Candidate URL presence is not image verification and does not establish that a URL works or depicts the correct place.
matchingPolicy: Exact slug match first; exact name match only when no slug match exists. No fuzzy matching was performed.

statusDefinitions.CANDIDATE_ADDED: A candidate URL has been collected, regardless of whether a current image also exists.
statusDefinitions.MISSING_CANDIDATE: No candidate URL has been collected; current-image availability is represented separately by hasCurrentImage.
statusDefinitions.MISSING_CURRENT_IMAGE: No current image URL exists; candidate-image availability is represented separately by candidateUrlExists.
